hook: Buy cheap now, take delivery tomorrow: every unit that comes Ashore grows your board, and the Hold hides surprises.
loop: Run units for 2 gold, or Seize them free on quiet turns.
Goods wait a turn in your Hold, then come Ashore.
Every arrival fires buffs, copies and triples; the board snowballs late.

growth.line: Small permanent buffs on every arrival, a few a turn; Pebble Jack and Nan multiply them late.

feel.early: Shaky: Runs put nothing on board until next turn.
feel.mid: Smugglers stack, arrivals pour in, quiet turns tempt.
feel.late: Copies, doubled triggers and a hidden fleet snowball.

stars.why: Fields hidden Hold units in the fight, a bench nobody can scout.
Copies every arrival, speeding triples and filling your hand.
Shows a tier-above unit you can only smuggle in.

builds.name: The night run
builds.line: Run three or four a turn; Nan copies arrivals into triples.

builds.name: Customs patience
builds.line: Alternate quiet turns; the herons Seize the best units free.

builds.name: The hidden fleet
builds.line: A full hand keeps goods in the Hold; Nyx fields them.

liked: All three picked Officer Nyx: hidden Hold units join fights opponents can't scout.
Now-or-later choice each turn plays unlike any other tribe; hand room is a dial.
worries: No Hold size cap: Creel Hauler and Grisel's +5/+5 may scale without end.
Officer Nyx unclear: do returned units come Ashore again, and which ones fight?
changed: Closed an endless loop: Nan's copies now skip the Hold.
Runner keyword renamed Smuggler, so it doesn't blur with the tribe name.
Pebble Jacks no longer stack; Kettle gold skips the Hold now.
verdict: Fun 6.3, distinct 7, ranked first of its three for the clearest growth engine; for planners who love economy and delayed payoffs.
